title: Co-op player 2 by robot: attacks and skills with the input state fix on / off
intro: Runs by itself. Co-op on the main pawn, the robot presses buttons; records DPC's controller bits, the pawn's input flags and nodes.

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active == true
probes.act: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.active == true
probes.btn: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.coop.last_btn or -1
probes.on: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.last_on_flags or -1
probes.pin: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local ok, v = pcall(function() return D.state.pawn_input:get_field('ButtonOnFlags') end); return ok and v or -1
probes.n1: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local pc = D and D.state.pawn_chara; return pc and H.node(pc, 1) or ''
probes.n0: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local pc = D and D.state.pawn_chara; return pc and H.node(pc) or ''
probes.tp: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local c = D and D.cfg; return c and tostring(c.coop_two_pads) .. '/' .. tostring(c.robot_frees_pad) .. '/' .. tostring(c.native_controls)
probes.busy: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local pc = D and D.state.pawn_chara; if not pc then return false end; local a, b = tostring(H.node(pc) or ''), tostring(H.node(pc, 1) or ''); local function busy(n) return n ~= '' and not n:find('Locomotion', 1, true) and not n:find('UpperBodyDefault', 1, true) and not n:find('Guard', 1, true) and not n:find('DrawWeapon', 1, true) end; return busy(a) or busy(b)
probes.sk: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local pc = D and D.state.pawn_chara; local ok,v=pcall(function() return pc:call('get_Human'):call('get_CustomSkillState') end); return ok and v or 0
probes.trg: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local ok, v = pcall(function() return D.state.pawn_input:get_field('ButtonTriggerFlags') end); return ok and v or -1
probes.pf: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.pipfix_n or 0
probes.npip: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.native.pip ~= nil and not D.native.failed
